须证明在申请前 6 个月内已取得 associate degree / dipl: You must show that you were awarded an associate degree, diploma or trade qualification within the 6 months immediately before applying, and that you meet the Australian study requirement for the 485 visa. This is evidence that the qualification has been completed, not proof of current enrolment — this stream is for people who have already graduated. **If more than 6 months have passed since graduation you can no longer apply**, which is different from the UK Graduate route, where the deadline is the expiry of the student visa.
